function: Single-antenna ISAC resource allocation: a SAC agent learns sensing energy and AIGC generating steps, LP allocates communication energy; the link has one antenna and no RIS (p. 3).
notes: Excluded as system. The SAC agent learns sensing energy and AIGC generating steps per user (p. 6; p. 7: 'a = {z1, ..., zK, d1, ..., dK}'), and the communication energy comes from the non-learned RCE/LP algorithm (p. 8). This is ISAC resource allocation (area 5), but the paper states 'Assume a single-antenna ISAC transceiver device' (p. 3) and each link uses a scalar channel gain and Shannon rate (p. 4, Eq. 5); no RIS, MIMO or beamforming appears in the text. Judgement call for the reviewer: if the learned decisions (AIGC generating steps, sensing energy for pose recognition) are read as above the physical layer, the code would be above_phy; both lead to exclusion. PDF is arXiv:2508.12079v2, a preprint; its title was not checked against the DOI record.
